proletarian revolution and the modern world

The contemporary world presents new challenges to proletarian revolution that were not foreseen in earlier Marxist analyses. Globalization has created complex interconnections between capital and labor, making traditional class struggle more nuanced. Technological advancement, particularly in information technology and artificial intelligence, is transforming the nature of work and economic relations.

Modern imperialism operates not just through direct colonial control, but through complex economic dependencies, cultural hegemony, and technological dominance.
